instructions: Warm cooked shrimp briefly in a skillet or serve chilled.
Spoon quinoa into a bowl; top with shrimp, cucumber, and tomato.
Crumble feta over and dress with olive oil and lemon.
Serve with Water, bottled, plain (360 g).
